ref.locator: Source: RSVZ/INASTI FAQ 'Hoeveel zal mijn pensioen bedragen?', https://www.rsvz.be/nl/faq/hoeveel-zal-mijn-pensioen-bedragen (retrieved 2026-10-20), table 'Jaarbedrag voor een volledige loopbaan (14.040/14.040) (vanaf 1/09/2026 aan spilindex 186,83)', row 'Minimum rustpensioen als alleenstaande'
ref.quote: Jaarbedrag voor een volledige loopbaan (14.040/14.040) (vanaf 1/09/2026 aan spilindex 186,83) Minimum rustpensioen als gezin € 28.219,84 Minimum rustpensioen als alleenstaande € 22.582,98
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Re-indexed on 1 Sept 2026. The 1 March 2026 amount, 22,139.15, was verified in the FPS Social Security notice (index_0326 PDF p. 11, IV. 'Regeling voor zelfstandigen', 3. 'Alleenstaande', a) 'Minimumpensioen (volledige loopbaan)'). That notice's self-employed household rate (27.655,22) differs from the employee one (27.665,22). The RSVZ and FPD now both give the same household rate, 28,219.84, so the discrepancy no longer matters. Legal minimum, not an average; full career = 14,040 days (45 years). It applied at 22,139.15 from March to August 2026. Holiday allowance and the July bijzondere bijslag/pensioenbijslag are excluded. For this line I would rank this unit first: most people with a self-employed pension have mixed careers, so no average describes a typical self-employed pensioner well. Researcher's working: - Same amount as the employee minimum (the minimums are aligned). Legal minimum, not an average. Note: the household rate in the self-employed block reads 27.655,22 EUR while the employee block reads 27.665,22 EUR in the same notice (probable typo in one of them; not used here). Same later-indexation caveat as the employee minimum.
